model: GLASS CURRENT GC-86 DIGITAL WAVETABLE SYNTHESIZER
rack: GLASS CURRENT, KUROSHIO's digital wavetable voice (an example rack's faceplate)
coordinate_space: the face's plate pixels at the house pitch for the face, the panel over it and the door hung below it (the open faceplate is 2140 x 788); the strip's own pixels; the host scales the whole rack uniformly

rack_pitch.note: EIA: 19 in panel, 1.75 in per unit

face.conversion: closed.png's box from x 14 y 175 scaled by 0.998134 on both axes, then 363 scaled rows planned to 394

panel.conversion: registered to closed.png by a shift of [-0.4699999988079071, -118.91999816894531] px, then scaled and its rows planned as the face's

door.conversion: as the panel, its rows continued below the face to the door's foot (664 rows)

strip.conversion: overview-r2.png's strip scaled by 1.9022 on both axes, its drawn proportion kept and centred in its unit (120 of 197 rows); its pixels strip-sharp.png's, registered by ECC onto that box and given overview-r2.png's tone

bindings: each element binds its rack unit (an index into the design's units) and the unit module's local key; the host resolves the registry parameter per placed rack

face:plate.note: the face scaled to the panel, its rows planned to 2U; the VFD's letters and bar, the POWER LED's light and the knobs' lines taken off

panel:plate.motion: drawn over the face plate at its anchor while the door is open
panel:plate.note: the open panel over the door's quarter, the hinges and the door's top: the lit page LED unlit, the LCD's labels and the soft knobs' lines taken off; its sides fade into the face

door:plate.motion: drawn below the face at its anchor while the door is open
door:plate.note: the hanging door below the face with its chart, at the face's scale; transparent round it

strip:plate.note: KUROSHIO's strip from strip-sharp.png, registered onto overview-r2.png's strip and sampled at 0.985 of its size, its drawn proportion kept and centred in its unit; the display's letters and the LED's light taken off

face:vfd.segment.lit.role: one lit segment of the VFD's bar with its half of the gaps either side, anchored at its middle
face:vfd.segment.lit.motion: drawn at each segment's middle while the bar shows

face:vfd.segment.unlit.role: one unlit segment of the VFD's bar with its half of the gaps either side, anchored at its middle
face:vfd.segment.unlit.motion: drawn at each segment's middle while the bar shows

face:power.lit.role: the lit POWER LED's lens and glow, anchored at the lens's middle

face:facet.rotor.role: the coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

face:drift.rotor.role: the coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

face:echo.rotor.role: the coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

face:horizon.rotor.role: the coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

panel:page.lit.role: DELAY's lit page LED with its glow on the button, anchored at the lens's middle
panel:page.lit.motion: shown on the chosen page's button

panel:soft1.rotor.role: soft knob 1's coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

panel:soft2.rotor.role: soft knob 2's coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

panel:soft3.rotor.role: soft knob 3's coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

panel:soft4.rotor.role: soft knob 4's coloured line, stored at 12 o'clock about its pivot

strip:power.lit.role: the strip's lit POWER LED, anchored at the lens's middle

procedural:lock-dot.renderer: the stack's yellow lock dot at each element's geometry.dot

procedural:focus-ring.renderer: 2 px amber ring, 3 px outside the hit shape
